response.text:
I can do that — before I proceed I need two quick confirmations so I delete the right messages and don’t remove anything you want to keep.

1) Scope — which messages do you want removed?
   - Option A (recommended): All messages from senders whose address contains "atlassian.com" (includes Jira/Bitbucket/Confluence notifications) dated in 2023 (older than 2024-01-01).
   - Option B: Any message with “Atlassian” (or “Jira”/“Bitbucket”) in the sender or subject dated in 2023.
   - If you want a different sender list or date range, tell me the exact criteria.

2) Action — do you want me to:
   - Delete (move to Trash; Gmail empties Trash after 30 days), or
   - Permanently delete now (if available), or
   - Archive / move to a label like "Atlassian-archive" instead of deleting (safer)?

If you confirm scope (pick A or B or give custom criteria) and which action to take, I will proceed. If you prefer, I can first show a small preview (e.g., up to 10 matching messages) for you to confirm before mass-deleting. Which would you like?
